name: bit-a-bit
description: Jogo educativo de lógica de programação para o concurso Framework Arcade

scripts.build:version: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const dir='dist'; if(!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir); fs.writeFileSync('dist/version.json', JSON.stringify({versao: process.env.npm_package_version, sha: process.env.GITHUB_SHA ? process.env.GITHUB_SHA.substring(0,7) : 'local', build: new Date().toISOString()}))"
